head: codex/issue-100-medium-launch-recovery
title: [v0.92][publication] Recover the 10 Medium launch article drafts to Google Drive
body:
Closes #100

## Summary
- recover all 10 canonical Medium launch drafts plus 24 supporting editorial and source records
- preserve 14 substantive variants with source revisions and SHA-256 provenance
- align all article headings to the launch-series plan and retain exact company Drive readback
- add a focused fail-closed recovery verifier and search inventory

## Validation
- live company Drive readback: PASS for 34 unique files under daniel@agent-logic.ai
- source and Drive SHA-256 parity: PASS
- current public-permission rejection: PASS
- retained variant provenance: PASS for 14 variants
- git diff --check: PASS
- no broad repository test suite was run for this docs/recovery-only issue

## Review
- independent exact-head review approved c42c9ea751d6d911dba9274ace80c2042c526dbe with no remaining findings
